name: Doomseal Press
description: Press a doomseal into the foe's field so his weaker techniques cannot rise at all.

name: Doomseal Pierce
description: Drive a narrow doomseal through the guard and leave it set deep in the body.

name: Doomseal Mend
description: Seat a doomseal over a grave wound to hold it closed in yourself or an ally.

name: Doomseal Cleanse
description: Seat a doomseal under a curse and cut it from its root in yourself or an ally.

name: Doomseal Hold
description: Hold the foe under a doomseal so no technique stirs in him until the seal is broken.

name: Doomseal Cover
description: Spread a doomseal over yourself and your allies that takes the heaviest blows unbroken.

name: Doomseal Wave
description: Roll a wave of doomseal outward that stills and strikes every foe it crosses.

name: Doomseal Snare
description: Lay a doomseal in the ground that closes over any foe who steps upon it.

name: Doomseal Edict
description: Pronounce the doomseal edict over the field so no foe within it may cast or speak.

name: Doomseal Nullity
description: Draw the doomseal tight about the user so no technique below its tier can touch him.

name: Sealed Return
description: Seal the last breath of one just fallen inside the body and then draw it back before the short window shuts.

name: Doomseal Closing
description: The school's closing move that lays the doomseal across the whole field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Ruinous Lock
description: Lock the qi of a whole host in one ruinous seal at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Doomseal Fall
description: Drop the whole doomseal on the field as one falling mass at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Heavenlock Press
description: Press the heavenlock onto the foe's field and keep his highest techniques from rising.

name: Heavenlock Pierce
description: Thrust a pin of the heavenlock through the guard and fix it in the foe's core.

name: Heavenlock Mend
description: Lock a grave wound shut with the heavenlock and let it knit in yourself or an ally.

name: Heavenlock Cleanse
description: Lock a curse or taint away from the body and cast it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Heavenlock Hold
description: Hold a foe in the heavenlock so no technique may be gathered in him.

name: Heavenlock Cover
description: Spread the heavenlock over yourself and your allies as a cover no common blow can break.

name: Heavenlock Wave
description: Roll the heavenlock out in a wave that locks and strikes every foe in its reach.

name: Heavenlock Snare
description: Lay the heavenlock into the ground so it rises and shuts on any foe who enters.

name: Heavenlock Edict
description: Pronounce the heavenlock edict so no foe in the field may call a technique.

name: Heavenlock Nullity
description: Wrap the user in the heavenlock so no lesser technique can reach him at all.

name: Breath Returned
description: Hold the breath of one just fallen behind the heavenlock and return it to him within the short window.

name: Heavenlock Closing
description: The school's closing move that lowers the heavenlock over the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Heavenlock Verdict
description: The school's judging move that passes the heavenlock on one foe and shields the user with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Heavenlock Fall
description: Bring the whole heavenlock down upon the field at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Heavenlock Shut
description: Shut the heavenlock on every foe in the field at once at the destructive ceiling of its tier.
